paragraphs.text:
A DeepSeek Harness
(dsh) plugin that gives a **text-only** LLM vision capability!!!

This release targets the DSH **0.2.x** plugin API, and is built and tested
against `dsh 0.2.1-rc.1`

(Cordis 4.0.5). The manifest declares
`engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`, so the launcher refuses to

load it on an
incompatible runtime instead of failing at call time.

Without `provider`/`model`, the tool reads the route from the calling
session's latest request heade

r, so the image is analyzed by the same model
that is driving the conversation.
Seriously, it is not a serious plugin 😝. The tool generates an ascii-art from the input image and fe
ed it into the text-only LLM to guess the content.

The keyless smoke test runs the real tool pipeline and LLM runtime against a
mock adapter:
